### Summary

The design mostly matches the revised contract (auth on item routes, offset cap, overflow 400), and all 29 acceptance criteria trace to defined rules. It is NOT-READY because the source-of-truth rules YAML does not parse (BR5.2), which blocks every mechanical consumer of rules.md. Two Major issues also remain: the unlogged, envelope-less 401 path contradicts BR5.1 and the approved criteria AC4.2.2 and AC3.1.1, yet traceability still marks those criteria plain OK.
